tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Finds the UUTOOLS.NET tools for a task – e.g. "heic to jpg", "compress pdf", "resize image for instagram", "mp4 to mp3" – and returns the best matches with a link to each tool page. Give the user the link: the tool runs on that page, free and without an account.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The UUTOOLS.NET tool categories (image, PDF, document, spreadsheet, presentation, vector, audio, video tools, unit converters, vehicle calculators) with a link to each.
